item.title: Lab Wins Silver Award at 2026 AgriTech Competition
item.description: Lab members received the Silver Award (銀獎) at the 2026 Agricultural Innovation Technology Competition (農業創新科技競賽) for developing a robotic tea-harvesting system. The project demonstrates the potential of robotics to improve efficiency and automation in agricultural operations.
